sn_aia_tool.description: Use this tool at the start of a document upload conversation to identify the client's active commercial account, case, and outstanding Financial Tasks (e.g. sales agreements, insurance certificates). Cross-references logged-in contact > company account, informs client of accepted file formats (PDF, JPG, PNG) and size limits (10 MB), and provides a personalized conversational greeting.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"contact_sys_id","description":"The customer contact sys_id","mandatory":false},{"name":"phone_number","description":"The customer phone number","mandatory":false},{"name":"case_number","description":"The loan case number or application number","mandatory":false},{"name":"account_sys_id","description":"The company account sys_id","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: identify_upload_requirements
